question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is "**designated**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The subject of the passage is the International form named G20.
 
• **Blank 5 will imply how the G20 forum names itself as the principal arena for international economic and financial co-operation.**
 
• Among the given options, **"designated" is the most appropriate word to fill in the blank as it fits the context of someone being assigned a specific role or position.**
 
• "Designated" means officially chosen or assigned for a particular purpose.(पदांकित)
 
 
• Example: He designated his son as his heir.
 
 
 
• The sentence could be rewritten as "G20 has been designated for a particular role or position".

Hence, **the correct answer is option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1, "values", does not fit the context as it is not related to assigning roles or positions.(मान)
 
• Option 3, "appointed", could also work in the sentence, but it implies a more formal or official assignment.(नियुक्त)
 
• Option 4, "offered", does not fit the context as it implies a voluntary or optional assignment. (प्रस्तुत)
